analysis.title: European Morning Note
key_insights: Eurostoxx futures (VGZ6) are down 0.2% in early trading. ESZ6 is also down 0.2% but about 1% above the early-morning lows.
The S&P gained 0.4% with four of 11 sectors advancing, led by technology. The Nasdaq rallied 0.7%, a day after entering a correction. Apple fell 1.9% after a mixed outlook.
Democrats swept both chambers of Congress. Nasdaq futures fell as much as 2.4% on the first reaction before trimming losses.
The KOSPI rallied 4% from its lows back to unchanged. The note reads this as market pricing being in line with odds markets on the midterm results.

The dollar is the cleaner expression of the result: USDJPY is back below 158, CHF is up 0.5%, and EUR and GBP are higher. Gold is up about $50 to about $3,980/oz and the UST 10-year yield is down 2bps to 4.94%.
The market reads the result as a rebuke of Trump and a narrower legislative runway, not as a growth scare.
AMD, ANET, ALAB and SMCI all reported beats with stronger outlooks, which cushions the AI complex.
Flows yesterday: sellers of European banks closing recent longs, buyers of ESZ6 adding fresh longs into continued market weakness, and sellers of MSCI World.

Apple fell 1.9% after delivering a mixed outlook (reported, no figures given).

The VIX is down from Monday's 21.15, which was the highest since June.
Scheduled for release at 15:00. The note lists the figure next to the release time without calling it a print, so it is treated as a forecast.
